programme.desc: In this fast-paced episode, host Theresa Visintin uses two unlikely ingredients that start with the letter "G," garbanzo beans and grapefruit! First up, Theresa cooks socca, a savoury garbanzo bean pancake recipe, and infuses it with Mediterranean flavours. To make her batter, Theresa combines chickpea flour with salty olives, sweet red pepper, and fresh basil. Once the batter is ready to go, she fries the savoury crepe. Next up, Theresa balances tart grapefruit with a sweet buttery lobster tail. But that's not sweet enough for Theresa! She prepares sabayon, a delicate honey custard that melts in your mouth. Finally, Theresa shows us how to make a mouth-watering dish by combining grapefruit and garbanzo.

programme.title: A is for Apple

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking the letter "L," Chef Robert Jewell takes on lamb and licorice in this ingredient challenge. He starts with aromatic Moroccan lamb riblets, an appetizer that will make you want this spicy dish as your main course too. Next, Robert takes it up a notch by showing us how to make licorice - yes, the candy! He brings coconut oil, brown sugar, creamed coconut, and molasses to boil before skillfully adding flour and anise to make sweet, chewy coconut licorice. Finally, Robert concocts the perfect recipe that combines succulent lamb with sweet licorice.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Host Theresa Visintin creates savoury meals in this letter "R" challenge featuring radicchios and raisins. First, Theresa chops up bold and bitter radicchios, grilling them until the edges are a crispy golden brown and perfect for a warm wedge salad. Then, she tosses fried pancetta and earthy portobello mushrooms in a luxurious champagne vinegar and pours it over the crispy radicchio. Theresa tops this warm salad with creamy crumbled goat's cheese. For her next dish, Theresa prepares a rum raisin sauce using golden sultana raisins, dark rum, and fresh orange. Theresa pours the sauce over succulent ham. Is your mouth watering yet? Finally, Theresa combines radicchio and raisin into a colourful and delicious side dish.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about pork and peanuts, today's challenge is the letter "P." Chef Lauren Gulyas serves up an old school favourite, smothered pork chops. Using a blend of savoury ingredients, and with the help of her cast iron pan, Chef Lauren provides us with tips on how to keep your pork tender and tasty. Next, it's time for a West African peanut soup. Drizzling garlic, ginger and onions with extra virgin olive oil and letting them sizzle in a frying pan until the onions are soft brings out a sweetness that lends itself beautifully to the salty, earthy taste of peanuts. To finish, Chef Lauren puts an Asian twist on a southern classic, when she combines the two ingredients.

programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic; Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Our fun and occasionally silly chef-host Kimberly Lallouz is taking on a Game Day menu for whatever bowl, cup, or ring your favourite team is bringing home this year! Wear your team colors and cook along as she updates perennial favourites like Chicken Wings (...grilled and smothered in savoury Suya spice!) and Loaded Nachos (with blue corn chips and decadently vegan with her chipotle-cashew 'cheeze!') Next, her Philly-style cheesy flank steak hoagie is a sure crowd pleaser, and for a final play, it's back to the grill with shrimp skewer made Buffalo-style with hot sauce, butter, and creamy avocado ranch dressing. Game on!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Not only do the racers in the Soap Box Derby have a need for speed, they have a need for BBQ! Matt and the RG team cook up a feast to slow down any speedster. The menu: Smoked Shrimp B.L.T., Pineapple Basil Rotisserie Chicken, Grilled Sweet Potato Pops, and Summer Berry Pudding.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Day By the Water
programme.desc: Matt spends the day by the water; fishing, playing Frisbee, catching some rays. What goes with water and sun? BBQ!!! Matt & his team make a seafood buffet of Grilled Clams in the Shell with Serrano Ham, Smoked Lake Rainbow Trout, Grilled Lobster with Grapefruit Salsa, and Crab-Stuffed Avocados.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt gets down and dirty playing some beach Volleyball. In between bumps, sets, and spikes, the RG team serves up a smorgasbord of great food. The menu: Grilled Chicken Breast on Foccacia with Grilled Apples & Cambozola Cheese, Sezchuan Ribs with Chunky Plum Dipping Sauce, Roasted Corn and Pepper Potato Salad, and Homemade Protein Bars

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Forget bicycle built for two. This Big Bike fits 30 people! Matt & the team join forces with the Heart & Stroke foundation to raise money by riding around a track. Matt feeds these 'bikers' some healthy and delicious grub. The menu: Grilled Calamari, Smoked Turkey Fajitas, Grilled Scallops and Watermelon Salsa, and Cold Gazpacho.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: It's a bird, it's a plane, it's a day of great BBQ. Inspired by the aerial acrobatics of CF18's and Harvards, Matt cooks up a variety of poultry and fowl. The menu: Bacon Wrapped Quail Stuffed with 3 Cream Cheeses, Raspberry Chipotle Turkey Wings, Grilled Balsamic Marinated Duck Breast, and Deviled Eggs.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Whether you're a pro or a beginner, everyone is welcome to join the Road Grill team at the 19th tee where Matt is busy burnin' up his Q's. What better way to end your day at the links with an enticing menu of Miso Citrus Grilled Sablefish, Smoked Rack of Pork with a Sour Cherry Sauce , Lemon Basil Smashed Potatoes with Mushrooms, Arugula Salad with Peaches, and Blue Cheese and Walnuts.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: In between hoisting sails and scrubbing the deck, Matt and his team prepare a feast for the sailors before going on a long voyage. Not only is the weather perfect for sailing, it's perfect for BBQing! The menu: Scallop Corn Bacon Burger, Maple-apple Brined Pork Chops, Grilled Tuna Bruschetta, and Strawberry Marscapone Trifle.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Teddy Bears of all age, shape, and size join our grill team with their owners for a day of games, rides and some teddy bear repair. programme.title: Road Grill

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Goma, Congo"
programme.desc: Bboy Junior is going back where he was born, The Democratic Republic of Congo. World champion Shigekix will join him, visiting Africa for the first time. Together they will explore the dance culture in the city of Goma.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Budapest"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace spends 3 days in Budapest, uncovering its invasion-shaped food culture and exploring the city on foot and by Cold War jeep.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Munich"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace discovers Munich’s Bavarian food and history over 3 days, revealing how the region helped shape Germany.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Gippsland, VIC - Part 2"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong continues his road trip through The Middle Of Everywhere or Central Gippsland. From Locals he learns how to catch European carp for an ancient recipe for fish sauce and how to hunt and butcher wild deer.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Hypnotherapy"
programme.desc: In Spain, two best friends reveal their big business plans at the end of a successful summer. A bar inches dangerously close to failure, and a rookie hypnotherapist finds his true calling in France.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: James returns to his former home city of Los Angeles, where he reconnects with old friends working in accessibility in the entertainment industry.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Seattle / Vancouver"
programme.desc: After a surprese invite to visit the head of accessibility at Microsoft's headquarters in Seattle, James heads to Vancouver, Canada's jewel of the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "New York City"
programme.desc: How does the bustling island of steel and stone fare for those with disabilities? James sets out to discover what it's like to travel blind in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Athens"
programme.desc: Two American street artists try to turn a school into a piece of art. Seems impossible, but this duo turns out to be a real American Dream Team.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Bangalore"
programme.desc: Two worlds collide in one of the busiest cities in the world when Mexico’s most famous street artist is meeting his equivalent on their home turf in India.

programme.title: Street Art Challenge S1 - "Rotterdam"
programme.desc: Two European street artists are teaming up in the Netherlands for the ultimate Street Art Challenge but Mother Nature seems to be doing everything to ruin it.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Mississippi, Alabama & Arkansas"
programme.desc: A hurricane in the south forces Lisa to change direction. We meet southern Van Lifers living under the radar in a state where the lifestyle is judged harshly. Tragically, Lisa’s story takes a heavy turn when she discovers that her father has died.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Texas"
programme.desc: A colourful graffiti artist in Austin shares her story of loss with Lisa and gives her a tarot reading. We travel to rural Texas to overnight with Jupiter: an outspoken, non-binary person of colour, living in their vintage RV while studying law.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Arizona"
programme.desc: Lisa spontaneously joins a sober dance party on a mountain top in Sedona, and meets spiritual Van Lifers who have dramatically changed their entire existence, including former NFL player Joe Hawley, and a transformative breathwork practitioner.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Los Angeles based electronic music producer and DJ Moe Espinosa, aka Drumcell, has created sonic soundscapes which tell cinematic stories with his music. Moe has always tried to avoid commercialism and by having a vision that remains independent.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Detroit"
programme.desc: Punk rocker Jon-Mikal formed his band The Idiot Kids as a way to deal with his sexuality. After coming out to his family at 21, he uses writing and his stage performance as a form of therapy.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "New York"
programme.desc: Rapper Shiniqua, aka Pretty Little Monster, juggles motherhood while trying to avoid the trappings of Instagram fame. Her passion is writing rap lyrics and always tries to keep it real.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Big Wave World Tour"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Big Wave World Tour
programme.desc: Trevor Carlson puts everything on the line to chase monster waves from Maui, Hawaii to Ensenada, Mexico.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Skimboarding Jaws"
programme.desc: Brad Domke aims for the big wave surfing history books by skimming the big waves of Pe’ahi.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Pe’ahi"
programme.desc: Will Skudin and Keali’i Mamala deal with the trials and tribulations of life as traveling big wave surfers.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: Marilia's Bali journey, focused on purification rituals, blended culture, healing, and adventure. From Tirta Empul's cleansing to exploring Ubud, embracing nature, and local traditions, she found serenity, capturing precious moments in her odyssey.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Malaysia"

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A rancher is shot dead after discovering oil on his property. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog..The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951 .It was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: An ex-con is released from prison seeking vengeance against those who put him there. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode first aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho work to uncover a cattle rustling operation.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog..The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho investigate when a railway detective is found dead.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode first aired in 1950.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective who is investigating a railroad holdup. Starring Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955. (This episode also features James Best (1926-2015), who would go on to appear on such shows as The Andy Griffith Show, Bonanza, and The Dukes of Hazzard.)

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark discovers the hideout of the famous Doolin gang. Clark, along with Detective Frankie, work to infiltrate the hideout and bring the Doolin gang to justice.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Directed by William Witney. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Leo Gordon, Joan Shawlee, Don Kennedy, Kenneth MacDoNald, Patrick Waltz, and Ken Chryson. First aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie work to save a young man from a hangman's noose in New Mexico.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Miachael Hall, Mitchell Kowall, and Jean Inness. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White.Series won an Emmy in 1955. (This episode features the beloved character actor Jack Elam as Black Jack Ketchum.)

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie investigate a cattle dispute in Wyoming. When evidence starts to add up, it leads them to Matt's old friend Tom Horn.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also sarring Louis Jean Heydt, Harry Woods, Michael Whalen, Stanley Andrews, and Walter Coy. Directed by William Witney. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Episode first aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After Farmer Perkins murders a store clerk in front of his wife, and is allowed to walk after his trial, the Cartwright's step in to make sure he'll be rearrested, tried, and hung.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After the Virginia City bank is robbed by an outlaw gang, the gangs youngest member gets a job on the Ponderosa. Initially welcomed, Little Joe becomes suspicious of Ponderosas newest member.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life from two gunmen, he explains that he is in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwright's to San Francisco to testify in a statewide racketeering trial, but the Deputy Marshal's motives for the witness soon become suspicious.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort. From 1960.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: With Tom Edwards ranch going to waste since his becoming a paraplegic following an accident with Ben, Ben makes a business proposition: The Cartwrights will build a mill on Edwards land. In return, Ben requests that he earn his investment money back as well as fifteen percent. The deal is made, but suspicions of Edwards accident bring tension to Ponderosa and put their agreement at risk.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho protect a man being chased by outlaws who believe he is responsible for a gold robbery. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of prison before she is hanged for murder.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog.. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A town blames the son-in-law of a the bank president for his murder. Cisco and Pancho work to uncover the truth before the townspeople hang the man. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: After arriving in the town of Sundance, Cisco witnesses the destruction of a newspaper office. Upon seeing this, Cisco contends with the man trying to take over the town. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark goes undercover working at a gambling den. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Episode first aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955. Also starring Dick SImmons, Claire Carleton, Mauritz Hugo, Howard Wright, and Douglas Evans.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Frankie is shot during a robbery. Her life becomes in danger when her doctor is kidnapped by the murderous outlaw Clay Allison.Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Jack Kelly, Paul Farber, Frank Fenton, and Fred Sherman.Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: A railroad detective pursues the infamous female outlaw, Belle Starr, after a herd of horses are stolen from the U.S. Calvalry. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Belle Starr is played by Mary Windsor. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as railroad detective Matt Clark who needs to track down a group of cattle rustlers along with their notorious leader Billy the Kid (played by Richard Jaeckel).This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook come across a girl in the woods who is running away from a man named Stark. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help an old woman find her son who has been missing for 18 years.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook help the long-lost son of a Cree tribal chief.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook go undercover as managers of a trading post. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A trader ignites a war between the Hurons and the settlers. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: After a long winter, the Tuscarora tribe struggles for survival. Hawkeye and Chingachcook set out to help.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingacchook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Tribesmen war over the daughter of a Mingo Chief. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Winter essentials are stolen on their way to a village. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.desc: 399 BC: The Trial of Socrates dramatises the famous trial of the Greek philosopher Socrates, who is charged with corrupting the youth and impiety. programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.title: Fenici e Greci gli Antichi negli Oceani
programme.sub-title: Fenici e Greci gli Antichi negli Oceani
programme.desc: From the ancient ruins of Tharros in Sardinia, we retrace the epic era of maritime exploration and colonisation by the Greeks and Phoenicians, stretching from the Black Sea to the Atlantic. At Palazzo Massimo in Rome, a first-century mosaic featuring a pineapple offers a fascinating clue—fuelling the theory that ancient sailors may have reached as far as the Americas.

programme.title: Dates that made history
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 1324 Mansa Musas Pilgrimage To Mecca
programme.desc: Mansa Musa's Pilgrimage to Mecca explores the extraordinary journey of Mansa Musa, the emperor of Mali, to Mecca in 1324. Highlighting the wealth and power of the Mali Empire as Musa’s caravan traverses the Sahara, spreading wealth and religious influence. It examines the impact of his pilgrimage on both the Islamic world and Africa’s place in global history. Through this journey, Mansa Musa’s legacy of generosity and cultural exchange becomes legendary.

programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.sub-title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Origini
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 Tra Reggio e Messina lo Stretto necessario
programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. Diver Domenico Majolino and marine biologist Simona Ratti explain its natural wonders, while Vincenzo Annuario tells the story of the Cariddi ferry, reborn after serving in the navy. At the National Archaeological Museum of Reggio Calabria, we discover the legacy of Magna Grecia and the famous Riace Bronzes. The 1908 earthquake that devastated Messina and Reggio Calabria is commemorated at the Regional Museum of Messina with the exhibition "1908 City Museum".

programme.title: il pane, le torte, la pizza
programme.sub-title: il pane, le torte, la pizza
programme.desc: Accompany, contain, support: three key concepts defining Italy's iconic culinary creations—bread, cakes, and pizza. Bread, a fundamental staple, complements dishes while holding symbolic meaning. Savory pies, rooted in medieval tradition, have remained unchanged through centuries. Lastly, pizza, an ancient grain-based dish, achieved global fame after merging with tomatoes in Naples. Massimo Montanari leads us through this rich and flavorful journey.

programme.desc: The Rai National Symphony Orchestra, under the baton of conductor Michele Mariotti, presents a captivating performance featuring the works of Franz Schubert and Richard Strauss. The orchestra's interpretation highlights the depth and emotional power of these renowned composers, creating a memorable concert experience.

programme.title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.sub-title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: Ernst is verliefd
programme.desc: Ernst is verliefd op het meisje achter de kassa. Als Bobbie daar achter komt. moet hij vreselijk lachen. Bobbie vindt wel dat Ernst het haar moet vertellen maar dat kost een moeite....

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: Waar is het water?
programme.desc: De directeur opent met veel tamtam de nieuwe drinkplaats voor de dieren. Als hij de kraan opendraait. komt er niets uit. geen water... Ernst en Bobbie zullen wel helpen zoeken...

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: Bobbie's verjaardag
programme.desc: Bobbie is jarig maar denkt dat Ernst zijn verjaardag is vergeten. Heel treurig loopt Bobbie door het park. Maar Ernst heeft een heel bijzonder plannetje...

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: De dieren willen niet eten
programme.desc: Het is heel vreemd maar de dieren in de dierentuin willen niet meer eten. Ernst en Bobbie proberen er achter te komen waarom ze niet meer eten? Ze hebben een oplossing maar of die werkt?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: De schoonmakers zijn ziek
programme.desc: De schoonmaker zijn ziek. Als de schoonmakers ziek zijn. willen Ernst en Bobbie wel helpen. Vrolijk beginnen ze aan de schoonmaak...maar niet van de kooien!

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: De krokodil is ontsnapt
programme.desc: Niemand begrijpt hoe het kan maar de krokodil is weg. Ernst en Bobbie gaan op onderzoek uit. En ze vinden hem! Hoe is het mogelijk...

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen in de Dierentuin: De dierentuin is honderd jaar
programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie willen een passend kado geven aan de directeur omdat de dierentuin 100 jaar bestaat. Alleen die 2 soepkippen raken het kado kwijt! Hoe moet het nu als ze de directeur tegenkomen? Hij verwacht natuurlijk een mooi kado!

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 De Troetelbeertjes: Wonderlijke Waarheden
programme.desc: Kleine beer wil graag aan iemand vertellen over de feitjes die ze heeft geleerd, maar niemand wil luisteren. Als vervolgens Riley allerlei leugens vertelt, luisteren de beertjes ineens wel. Maar wat ze niet weten is dat ze beter naar Kleine beer kunnen luisteren.

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.desc: De beertjes kunnen altijd erg goed samen werken, totdat zij een schatkaart ontdekken. De beertjes gaan individueel op zoek met het doel de schat als eerste te vinden. Ze komen er al gauw achter dat ze de schat alleen kunnen vinden als ze samenwerken.

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Cry Babies: De grote verrassing
programme.desc: De langverwachte dag is eindelijk aangebroken! Alles is wit bedekt en de Cry Babies zijn er klaar voor om het huis en de boom te versieren, maar wacht ... iemand vergat de boom te kopen! Wat gaan ze doen?

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van het kapotte bed
programme.desc: Pieter breekt het bed wat zijn vader voor hem heeft gemaakt. Terwijl hij het probeert te maken leidt dit tot onverwachte avonturen.

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van die ene die ontsnapte
programme.desc: Een vis vangen is moeilijker dan het lijkt. En.. wat doe je met een mega forel als je hem eenmaal gevangen hebt...

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E28 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van de losgeslagen vliegers
programme.desc: Benjamin is tegen zijn wil een pagagier van een vlieger en roept om hulp. Kunnen Pieter en Lilly hun meningsverschil opzij zetten en Benjamin te hulp schieten?

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van het heldenkonijn
programme.desc: Wanneer een groepje wanhopige muizen Benjamin aanzien voor een held en hem willen inhuren voor het terughalen van de gestolen erwten krijgt hij meer dan hij aankan.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel: De Liefdesbrief
programme.desc: De kasteelheer is verliefd! Hij heeft een brief gestuurd naar zijn geliefde maar zij blijkt door Ernst en Bobbie gezien te zijn met een andere man. Het geluk van de kasteelheer valt in duigen…of toch niet?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen op het Kasteel: De Viswedstrijd
programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie mogen meedoen aan een grote viswedstrijd. Bobbie laat per ongeluk de grote vissen die de kasteelheer gevangen heeft ontsnappen…..Hoe lossen ze dit nu weer op?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E79 De Smurfen: Het Stinkei
programme.desc: Terwijl de Smurfen zich voorbereiden op het Festival van de Sterren, plant Gargamel een wezen tussen hen dat zo verschrikkelijk stinkt dat hij gemakkelijk naar het Smurfendorp kan worden gevolgd.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E80 De Smurfen: De Smurfbrandweer
programme.desc: Het Smurfendorp richt een brandweerkorps op om de vlammen in Gulzige's keuken te bestrijden, maar ontdekt dat Gargamel al het water heeft meegenomen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E81 De Smurfen: Ieder Schilderij Smurft Een Verhaal
programme.desc: De boosaardige Maestro's magische verf heeft de kracht om zijn modellen voor altijd op doek te transporteren! Grote Smurf instrueert Schilder Smurf om zijn verf te verwisselen.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa zijn op bezoek bij hun vrienden Aki en Aku in Lapland, bij de Noordpool. Zij hebben een speciale speurtocht voor Chavapa’s verjaardag georganiseerd. Om dit te vieren, moeten Mouk en Chavapa de weg vinden naar de hut van de tweeling in de bossen.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur in de Amazone, waar ze op zoek gaan naar ’n papegaaienveer en wat bessen, zodat ze een brief naar Popo en Mita kunnen schrijven.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur in Borneo, waar ze hun vriend en zijn vader die een wetenschapper is helpen bij het zoeken van de Argusfazant.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Rode Panda
programme.desc: Vandaag ga ik naar de rode panda’s van DierenPark Amersfoort! We halen bamboe en maken het verblijf klaar voor een nieuwe dag. Ik kijk mee bij de training van de panda’s door dierverzorger Mirthe om hen voor te bereiden op de grote verhuizing.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Reptielen
programme.desc: Wij bezoeken het Honderdduizend Dierenhuis van DierenPark Amersfoort. Hier wonen slangen, leguanen, de kameleon en zelfs de vogelspin. Samen met dierverzorger Paul zorg ik voor het voedsel van alle reptielen en insecten.

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: De Koning en de Koningin
programme.desc: De koning en de koningin hebben vandaag geen zin om te regeren. Wat nu?

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: Ik loop als een beer
programme.desc: We lopen als een beer, we stampen als een olifant en we sluipen als een tijger.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Bibaboerderij: Kaas In de Pot
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E82 De Smurfen: De Gevleugelde Tovenaar
programme.desc: Gargamel doet beroep op zijn grote toverspreukenboek om te kunnen vliegen. Hij is vastberaden om al vliegend een Smurf te vangen voor de tovenaarsbijeenkomst. Enkele mislukte spreuken maken hem tot de grap van de conventie.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E83 De Smurfen: De Eerste Telesmurf
programme.desc: Grote Smurf giet een magisch drankje over het nieuwe Smurfmeloenen veld, waardoor het direct groeit en zich verspreidt over het hele dorp en bos. De Smurfen gebruiken de bloesems als een telefoon, maar voordat Gargamel hun stemmen kan volgen, veranderen de bloemen in meloenen en is Telesmurf niet meer.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E84 De Smurfen: Mutsje Af Voor De Smurfen
programme.desc: Op zoek naar iets nieuws, draagt Hippe Smurf een door Gargamel gemaakte magische hoed die zijn gezicht in een chaos verandert. Door sluwheid weet Grote Smurf het tegengif van de gemene tovenaar te krijgen en wordt Hippe Smurf opnieuw mooi.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E85 De Smurfen: Geen Tijd Voor Smurfen
programme.desc: Brilsmurf, Knutselsmurf, Klunsige Smurf en Smurfin ontdekken in een grot een wonderlijke zandloper. Door hun geklungel slagen ze erin om de tijd te doen spinnen en zonder het te weten veroorzaken ze enkele tijdelijke paradoxen waardoor de wereld een grote warboel wordt...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E86 De Smurfen: De Gouden Smurfenprijs
programme.desc: Het is lente, een leuke tijd om een smurfenprijs uit te reiken. Intussen, ver weg van het smurfendorp, werkt de boosaardige tovenares Agatha aan een plan op om Smurfen te vangen voor haar schoonheidscrème.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E87 De Smurfen: De Breinsmurf
programme.desc: Door een wild experiment is Klungelsmurf in staat om eindeloze kennis in zijn geheugen op te slaan. Gargamel vangt hem en probeert de onzichtbaarheidsformule van Grote Smurf te ontsleutelen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E88 De Smurfen: Beter Een Goede Buursmurf Dan …
programme.desc: Nadat zijn huisje is afgebrand, wordt Brilsmurf opgevangen door de andere Smurfen. Echter één na één zetten ze hem terug op straat door zijn gezaag. Hij verlaat het dorp en gaat in een grot wonen.Grote Smurf gaat naar hem op zoek…

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E89 De Smurfen: Een Beetje Smurfvertrouwen
programme.desc: Grote Smurf geeft Slappe Smurf een speciale crème om te dragen die zijn kracht zal herstellen. Kort daarna wordt hij beloond voor zijn moedige daden. Zijn zelfvertrouwen stijgt enorm wanneer hij beseft dat de crème eigenlijk smurfenbessenjam is.

programme.desc: Naranjina zwaait de kadekapers uit: prettige vakantie, tot snel! Daarna gaat ze vrolijk terug naar binnen…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Liefs van Ruben
programme.desc: Naranjina en de kadekapers rennen als gekken over de kade. Dokko rent achter ze aan. Vluchten ze voor Dokko? Nee, ze rennen achter een bankbiljet aan dat wappert op de wind. Uiteindelijk blijft het hoog in een kraan hangen. Naranjina baalt ervan: ze hebben al zo weinig verdiend vandaag.

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E62 Cry Babies: De Jellies: Levende tranen
programme.desc: Het sap van de Tutti Frutti-baby’s is zo lekker dat de baby’s uit de Vallei huilen van geluk als ze ervan mogen proeven, maar deze keer zijn er niet de gebruikelijke magische tranen: het zijn Jellies!

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E69 Cry Babies: Het Tutti Frutti-parfum
programme.desc: Grace maakt een nieuw parfum dat naar fruit ruikt. Ze doet een beetje van haar parfum op om het uit te proberen en als ze van huis weggaat zijn de andere Cry Babies Tutti Frutti in de ban van de geweldige geur…

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S03 : E59 Cry Babies: Het Tutti Frutti-feestmaal
programme.desc: Angie en Nana zijn aan het koken als ze besluiten de Cry Babies Magic Tears van Fantasy-wereld en van de Vallei uit te nodigen voor een feestmaal in Tutti Frutti-baai. Zal het een leuke bijeenkomst worden voor alle Cry Babies?

programme.title: Cry Babies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Cry Babies: De grote verrassing
programme.desc: De langverwachte dag is eindelijk aangebroken! Alles is wit bedekt en de Cry Babies zijn er klaar voor om het huis en de boom te versieren, maar wacht ... iemand vergat de boom te kopen! Wat gaan ze doen?

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.desc: Als jij verdwaald bent, wie zou jij dan vertrouwen om de weg terug te vinden? De kinderen kunnen niet kiezen tussen Badtz-Maru en Daniël. Maar we mogen ook Pochacco niet vergeten, hij heeft namelijk een ‘neus’ voor dit soort dingen.

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Hello Kitty: De mars van de Badtz-Maru’s
programme.desc: Badtz-Maru gaat op een te gekke reis helemaal naar de Zuid pool! Onderweg komt hij achter de betekenis van echte vriendschap.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest: De Verjaardag van Ernst
programme.desc: Liveshow van Ernst en Bobbie waarin de verjaardag van Ernst wordt gevierd. Alleen...zijn kado wordt gestolen!

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Hello Kitty: Klein is fijn deel 1
programme.desc: Als jij maar een meter lang zou zijn, dan zou jij je wel klein voelen toch? Keroppi gebruikt zijn zelf bedachte dapperheid om boven de rest uit te komen ondanks zijn verticale uitdaging.

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Hello Kitty: Klein is fijn deel 2
programme.desc: In het twee deel van dit verhaal zitten Kitty en haar vrienden vast in een grot! Zij leren allemaal dat er ook voordelen zijn aan klein zijn.

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.desc: Dribbel wordt zo vroeg wakker dat mama en papa nog slapen. Dus Dribbel besluit om zijn eigen ontbijt te bereiden en maakt daarbij een hoop rommel!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.sub-title: S03 : E30 Dribbel: Het paard van Dribbel
programme.desc: Dribbel, Helen en Steve hadden veel plezier door te doen alsof veel verschillende objecten in de tuin hun stokpaardjes zijn. Sally's bezem werkt het beste!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.sub-title: S03 : E31 Dribbel: Dribbel en zijn opa
programme.desc: Opa komt op bezoek en neemt Dribbel mee naar het park, ze hebben zo'n spannende tijd dat opa in slaap valt voordat hij de kans heeft gehad om Dribbel zijn verhaaltje voor het slapengaan voor te lezen!

programme.title: Dribbel
programme.desc: Het regent en Dribbel wil bij Tom gaan spelen, gelukkig heeft hij zijn eigen paraplu om hem droog te houden. Dribbel ziet dat sommige dieren, zoals de eenden, van de regen houden, maar dat anderen, zoals de konijnen, er lang niet zo van houden.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Boes: Mama Ping loopt weg
programme.desc: Mama Ping is het zat om voor haar kinderen te zorgen. Ze wil graag een keer uitrusten en een dutje doen. Mama Ping loopt weg en laat papa Biton achter bij de kleintjes, maar papa kan het niet alleen aan en Boes probeert babysitters in te huren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Boes: Boes vist maar net
programme.desc: Boes gaat vissen en verzamelt een regenworm. De regenworm wil liever niet door een vis worden opgeslokt en probeert te ontsnappen. Boes probeert hem te overtuigen, maar de regenworm wil niet luisteren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Boes: Liefde doet pijn
programme.desc: Willy is verliefd op een vrouwelijke neushoorn. Hij heeft alleen wel een rivaal met een taaie en grote hoorn. Willy daagt zijn rivaal uit voor een duel, maar hij verliest het omdat zijn hoorn zo zacht is als een ballon. Boes heeft een idee!

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Popo en Mita over het kleurrijke Holi-feest dat ze meemaakten in India.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa denken terug aan hun avontuur op Kreta, waar ze Cassandra helpen om haar Xylofoon te maken, zodat ze kan optreden op het dorpsfestival.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa zijn op bezoek bij hun vriend Tucson in Utah. Zijn moeder toont hen hoe ze afdrukken maakt van oude voetsporen van dinosaurussen.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus: Kortsluiting
programme.desc: Er is vanavond een nachtvoorstelling in het circus. Alle lampen worden gecontroleerd. Als Bobbie per ongeluk zijn boemerang weggooit, komt deze in de elektriciteitskast terecht....kortsluiting! Lukt het Ernst en Bobbie om alles te regelen voordat de voorstelling start?

programme.title: De Prins van Oranje
programme.desc: Bestaan er prinsen die in sinaasappelen leven? En hoe redt de dappere prinses Aya haar sinaasappel-prins dan uit de handen van een reus? Of trouwt ze alsnog met een kwaadaardige kikker?

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus: Lolo de Aap
programme.desc: Lolo de aap wil niet meer eten. De Circusdirecteur is ten einde raad. Zo kan de voorstelling niet doorgaan! Ernst en Bobbie gaan eens kijken bij de aap. Als Bobbie per ongeluk de deur open laat staan, ontsnapt de aap en kunnen Ernst en Bobbie zoeken. Als de Circusdirecteur het maar niet ziet!

programme.title: Koos & Moos

programme.title: Hello Kitty
programme.desc: De slimme pinquin Badtz-Maru toont zijn alter-ego: de grote en machtige XO Man! Hij is gekomen om de wereld te redden, al is het alleen in Badtz-Maru’s gedachten.

programme.title: De Prins van Oranje

programme.sub-title: S2026 : E04 Epic Moments From Megalodon Driver Ashley Sanford Compilation
programme.desc: Hold onto your seats as Ashley Sanford takes the wheel of Megalodon for a series of high-stakes performances across Charlotte, OKC, and Wichita. The intensity reaches a fever pitch as she battles to secure her first BKT overall event Championship win of the year, pushing the iconic shark-themed truck to its absolute limit. Witness technical mastery in the Skills competition with incredible "stoppies" and "nose walks" before diving into a freestyle frenzy featuring the legendary Morgan and Morgan backflip. From surviving a wild side-roll to launching into massive "sky wheelies," this episode captures every heart-stopping second of a driver on the hunt for glory.

programme.sub-title: S2026 : E05 2026 Monster Jam Lineup Compilation
programme.desc: The 2026 season kicks off with an electric atmosphere as the world’s most elite drivers descend upon Brooklyn and Tampa for a showcase of raw power and technical brilliance. Witness the intensity reach a fever pitch during the first "father and son" Racing matchup of the year, where family ties are set aside in the pursuit of the next round. Competitors push their machines past the breaking point in Freestyle, featuring high-stakes maneuvers like the Morgan & Morgan backflip and a spectacular "Maximum moonwalk" performed from never-before-seen angles. With hoods flying and trucks performing impossible cartwheels to save their runs, this episode captures every heart-stopping moment of a lineup coming out "swinging with a ton more energy".

From the legendary Grave Digger to the prehistoric power of Megalodon, every moment is packed with the raw energy and engine-roaring excitement that only Monster Jam can provide.
